verdict.rationale: Stripe documents isolated sandboxes for testing your account's functionality without affecting live mode or moving funds. Test cards simulate successful payments and declines, fraud, and invalid-data errors. Sandboxes can be created from the CLI, and the Workbench Shell supports building and testing in a sandbox. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of test cards or flows that simulate disputes, any statement that the sandbox fully mirrors production behavior, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the testing experience.
